 Post published at 48 mins 48 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Aston Villa look to make a bright start as they did in the first half. They win a corner and it's swung in by Matty Cash but eventually caught by Gianluigi Donnarumma and chucked away.
 133 44 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:34 BST 13:34 BST 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Manchester City won their most recent Premier League game in which they trailed at half time, beating Bournemouth 2-1 on the opening weekend of the season, having failed to win one in either of the previous two campaigns (D2 L8).
 But, Aston Villa are unbeaten in their last 20 Premier League games when leading at half time (W17 D3) since a 1-4 defeat against Spurs in November 2024.
 129 25 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Emery's 'level of detail is phenomenal' published at 13:33 BST 13:33 BST 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 I think Unai Emery's man-management skills are absolutely brilliant. 
 And I have watched him take training sessions and the level of detail is phenomenal. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 204 36 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 13:33 BST 13:33 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Guehi is a good defender but he's making a lot of mistakes which are costing us.
 John 
 Guehi is always prone to errors against decent opposition, poor aerially too, not sure he’s cut out for a back four.
 LB 
 147 41 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 KICK-OFF published at 13:33 BST 13:33 BST 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Away we go.
 119 10 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 13:33 BST 13:33 BST 
 HT: Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Unsurprisingly, Marc Guehi is hooked at the break. As is Rayan Cherki.
 Phil Foden and Rico Lewis are on.
 72 54 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:32 BST 13:32 BST 
 HT: Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 It looks like Phil Foden and Rico Lewis are ready to come on.
 50 59 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Emery 'so intense' published at 13:32 BST 13:32 BST 
 HT: Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Rachel Corsie 
Former Aston Villa defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 With Emery he's quite unique, well a lot of coaches will focus on the tactical detail, but he's so intense with it. 
 Him saying the only salvation he has is when he has when he has days off but I remember when I was here that his car is literally always at the training ground - and I know that's the natural thing but I would say it's an incredible amount of time. 
 He loves to get the detail right and he spends a lot of time individually. 
 85 20 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Jackson is a man oozing confidence' published at 13:30 BST 13:30 BST 
 HT: Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Joleon Lescott 
Former Aston Villa defender on TNT Sports 
 Marc Guehi will get most of the slack for the touch but he's surrounded and hasn't got many options.
 Nicolas Jackson is patient and forces the pass to Guehi. 
 Jackson is a man oozing confidence at the moment. 
 136 19 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:28 BST 13:28 BST 
 HT: Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 A quiet afternoon so far for the big man...
 Image source, BBC Sport 
 84 38 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 13:25 BST 13:25 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Honestly, we need to talk about Suzuki. What a keeper - claims well from crosses, good shot stopper, excellent distribution. Arsenal, he’s the life after Raya. I’m calling it now.
 Tre-Joshua 
 262 576 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:23 BST 13:23 BST 
 HT: Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Only Erling Haaland (12) has scored more goals among Premier League players in all competitions this season than Nicolas Jackson (6).
 Image source, Getty Images 
 209 46 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 13:18 BST 13:18 BST 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Aston Villa with the lead at the break.
 City have been on top since that 6th-minute goal from Nicolas Jackson but have nothing to show for it.
 Changes incoming?
 Image source, Getty Images 
 480 87 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Jackson is causing chaos' published at 13:18 BST 13:18 BST 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Owen Hargreaves 
Former Manchester United midfielder on TNT Sports 
 Nicolas Jackson is causing chaos out there for Man City, running the channels and being physical. 
 587 86 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 45 mins 45 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 The referee blows up for a foul on Josko Gvardiol by Alysson but Ruben Dias fancies having a dig of his own after the whistle and challenges Alysson.
 68 123 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 13:14 BST 13:14 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 As a neutral, I can only marvel at Emery. He improves players to such an extent they get picked off every season by the so called big boys then does it all over again. HE is the best manager currently.
 Sandra 
 2011 341 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'It'll be interesting to see how Maresca changes things' published at 13:13 BST 13:13 BST 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Lucy Ward 
Former Leeds striker on TNT Sports 
 If Enzo Maresca doesn't think the central midfield is working he'll change it at half time. 
 It'll be interesting to see how he'll change it. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 159 105 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 42 mins 42 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 City have made 27 touches in the opposition box against Aston Villa, the most by any side in the first half of a Premier League game this season.
 Nothing to show for it so far.
 277 79 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Manzambi is a handful' published at 13:12 BST 13:12 BST 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Lucy Ward 
Former Leeds striker on TNT Sports 
 Such a handful Johan Manzambi, he's prepared to do the work when Villa haven't got the ball. 
 He wants to challenge and wants to tackle, he gets right in there.
